people.name: Elam
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of Babylon; ally and enemy of Israel

people.name: Kir
people.line: A city or region in Mesopotamia, possibly Elam

translations.web: Elam carried his quiver, with chariots of men and horsemen; and Kir uncovered the shield.
translations.bsb: Elam takes up a quiver, with chariots and horsemen, and Kir uncovers the shield.
translations.kjv: And Elam bare the quiver with chariots of men and horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.
